notes: New: Lab Snapshot. Photograph any lab worksheet and StudyLens spots what kind of lab it is, then loads the matching practice module — geology strike & dip and cross sections, topographic contours, titration, microscope & curves, vectors, data charts — with fresh numbers every round, a diagram you can draw on, step-by-step checking, plus your own notes and a research panel beside the work.

Your photo stays on your device and isn't saved: the reading only detects the lab type, then what was read is dropped. Practice comes from StudyLens's own templates with randomized values — never from your sheet's words or numbers. Your notes are your own writing, kept on this device only.
